verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־ לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ maś·kîl liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ šā·ma‘·nū bə·’ā·zə·nê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū sip·pə·rū- lā·nū pō·‘al pā·‘al·tā ḇî·mê·hem bî·mê qe·ḏem
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Maskil of the sons of Korah We have heard with our ears O God our fathers have told us the work You did in their days in the days of old

verses.original: יָדְךָ֡ אַתָּ֤ה׀ ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ גּוֹיִ֣ם וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏə·ḵā ’at·tāh hō·w·raš·tā gō·w·yim wat·tiṭ·ṭā·‘êm tā·ra‘ lə·’um·mîm wat·tə·šal·lə·ḥêm
verses.literal: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted [our fathers] there You crushed the peoples and cast them out

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא־ הוֹשִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי־ יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ḇə·ḥar·bām yā·rə·šū ’ā·reṣ ū·zə·rō·w·‘ām lō- hō·wō·šî·‘āh lā·mōw kî- yə·mî·nə·ḵā ū·zə·rō·w·‘ă·ḵā wə·’ō·wr pā·ne·ḵā kî rə·ṣî·ṯām
verses.literal: For it was not by their sword that they took the land their arm did not bring them victory . . . It was by Your right hand Your arm and the light of Your face because You favored them

verses.original: אַתָּה־ ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh- hū mal·kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣaw·wêh yə·šū·‘ō·wṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: You . . . are my King O God who ordains victories for Jacob

verses.original: בְּ֭ךָ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ צָרֵ֣ינוּ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵā nə·nag·gê·aḥ ṣā·rê·nū bə·šim·ḵā nā·ḇūs qā·mê·nū
verses.literal: Through You we repel our foes through Your name we trample our enemies

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א אֶבְטָ֑ח בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ’eḇ·ṭāḥ ḇə·qaš·tî wə·ḥar·bî lō ṯō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: For I do not trust in my bow nor does my sword . . . save me

verses.original: כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî hō·wō·ša‘·tā·nū miṣ·ṣā·rê·nū ū·mə·śan·’ê·nū hĕ·ḇî·šō·w·ṯā
verses.literal: For You save us from our enemies You put those who hate us to shame

verses.original: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁמְךָ֓׀ נוֹדֶ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֖ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm hil·lal·nū ḵāl hay·yō·wm wə·šim·ḵā nō·w·ḏeh lə·‘ō·w·lām se·lāh
verses.literal: In God we have boasted all day long . . . and Your name we will praise forever Selah

verses.original: אַף־ זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־ תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- zā·naḥ·tā wat·taḵ·lî·mê·nū wə·lō- ṯê·ṣê bə·ṣiḇ·’ō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: But You have rejected and humbled us You no longer go forth with our armies

verses.original: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי־ צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šî·ḇê·nū ’ā·ḥō·wr min·nî- ṣār ū·mə·śan·’ê·nū šā·sū lā·mōw
verses.literal: You have made us retreat . . . from the foe and those who hate us have plundered us

verses.original: תִּ֭תְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל זֵרִיתָֽנוּ׃ וּ֝בַגּוֹיִ֗ם
verses.transliteration: tit·tə·nê·nū kə·ṣōn ma·’ă·ḵāl zê·rî·ṯā·nū ū·ḇag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured You have scattered us among the nations

verses.original: תִּמְכֹּֽר־ עַמְּךָ֥ בְלֹא־ וְלֹ֥א־ ה֑וֹן רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tim·kōr- ‘am·mə·ḵā ḇə·lō- wə·lō- hō·wn rib·bî·ṯā bim·ḥî·rê·hem
verses.literal: You sell Your people for nothing no profit do You gain from their sale

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·śî·mê·nū ḥer·pāh liš·ḵê·nê·nū la·‘aḡ wā·qe·les lis·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors a mockery and derision to those around us

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד־ רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: tə·śî·mê·nū mā·šāl bag·gō·w·yim mə·nō·wḏ- rōš bal- ’um·mîm
verses.literal: You have made us a byword among the nations a laughingstock . . . among the peoples

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃ פָּנַ֣י
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm kə·lim·mā·ṯî neḡ·dî ū·ḇō·šeṯ kis·sā·ṯə·nî pā·nay
verses.literal: All day long . . . my disgrace is before me and shame has covered my face

verses.original: מִ֭קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl mə·ḥā·rêp̄ ū·mə·ḡad·dêp̄ mip·pə·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ ū·miṯ·naq·qêm
verses.literal: at the voice of the scorner and reviler because of the enemy bent on revenge

verses.original: כָּל־ זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא־ שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- zōṯ bā·’aṯ·nū wə·lō šə·ḵa·ḥă·nū·ḵā wə·lō·ši- šiq·qar·nû biḇ·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: All this has come upon us though we have not forgotten You . . . or betrayed Your covenant

verses.original: לִבֵּ֑נוּ לֹא־ נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר אֲשֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ וַתֵּ֥ט מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bê·nū lō- nā·sō·wḡ ’ā·ḥō·wr ’ă·šu·rê·nū wat·têṭ min·nî ’ā·rə·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: Our hearts have not turned back . . . our steps have not strayed from Your path

verses.original: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḏik·kî·ṯā·nū bim·qō·wm tan·nîm wat·tə·ḵas ‘ā·lê·nū ḇə·ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals You have covered us . . . with deepest darkness

verses.original: אִם־ שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ זָֽר׃ לְאֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: ’i·mō·šā- šā·k̲aḥ·nû šêm ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wan·nip̄·rōś kap·pê·nū zār lə·’êl
verses.literal: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים זֹ֑את יַֽחֲקָר־ כִּֽי־ ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמ֥וֹת לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm zōṯ ya·ḥă·qār- kî- hū yō·ḏê·a‘ ta·‘ă·lu·mō·wṯ lêḇ
verses.literal: would not God have discovered . . . since He knows the secrets of the heart

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל־ הַיּ֑וֹם נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·le·ḵā hō·raḡ·nū ḵāl hay·yō·wm neḥ·šaḇ·nū kə·ṣōn ṭiḇ·ḥāh
verses.literal: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long . . . we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered

verses.original: ע֤וּרָה׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן׀ הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל־ תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·rāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy lām·māh ṯî·šan hā·qî·ṣāh ’al- tiz·naḥ lā·ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: Wake up O Lord Why are You sleeping Arise Do not reject us forever . . .

verses.original: לָֽמָּה־ תַסְתִּ֑יר פָנֶ֥יךָ תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עָנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- ṯas·tîr p̄ā·ne·ḵā tiš·kaḥ ‘ā·nə·yê·nū wə·la·ḥă·ṣê·nū
verses.literal: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression

verses.original: כִּ֤י נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ
verses.transliteration: kî nap̄·šê·nū šā·ḥāh le·‘ā·p̄ār biṭ·nê·nū dā·ḇə·qāh lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For our soul has sunk to the dust our bodies cling to the earth

verses.original: ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·māh ‘ez·rā·ṯāh lā·nū ū·p̄ə·ḏê·nū lə·ma·‘an ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Rise up be our help Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion
